title: School Day Steps
hook: Different parts of the day ask for different tools.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: clean 3D classroom storybook, colorful supplies, simple desks, isolated objects; visual identity: School Day Steps

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child narrating one school day in time
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: object fact anchored to plausible day phase
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: time-neutral recall so no target gets a false schedule claim
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Turn School Day Steps into a real day arc: arrive, settle, learn, make, read, practice, pack, and leave; objects appear where they make temporal sense instead of on one endless walk.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child moves through a school day with changing energy and task type; the same room feels different during reading, making, practice, and pack-up.
